label: NATS MQTT bridge example
info: Node-RED publishes through NATS MQTT; Nuclio consumes the native NATS subject and publishes the transformed result back through the MQTT listener.

name: example-nats-mqtt-transform
configCode:
apiVersion: "nuclio.io/v1"
kind: NuclioFunction
spec:
  build:
    commands:
      - pip install nats-py
  triggers:
    nats:
      kind: nats
      url: nats://nats:4222
      attributes:
        topic: example.nats.mqtt.input
        queueName: demo-nats-mqtt
        reply: false

name: NATS subject through MQTT
info: Node-RED publishes to example/nats/mqtt/input through NATS's MQTT listener. The Nuclio NATS trigger consumes example.nats.mqtt.input and publishes the transformed result to example.nats.mqtt.output, which NATS delivers back to Node-RED over MQTT.
